item.title: JavaScript Date Manipulation Best Practices for Calculating Future Dates
item.description:
“JavaScript Date Manipulation Best Practices for Calculating Future Dates”

How does one reliably calculate a date one or more days in the future using JavaScript, especially when accounting for complex time shifts like Daylight Saving Time (DST) transitions? Developers often seek methods that are concise, accurate across time zones, and avoid common pitfalls associated with simple millisecond addition or flawed setDate operations.

Various approaches exist, ranging from utilizing the native Date object’s capabilities to leveraging external libraries. Below are several effective techniques presented to address this common programming challenge.
